name: total_active_s
definition: sum of screen_exit.dwellMs over all screens (seconds)

name: engine_dwell_s
definition: screen_exit.dwellMs summed on the live-negotiation screen (seconds)

name: total_idle_s
definition: sum of idle_end.idleMs (seconds of detected inactivity)

name: n_tab_away
definition: count of visibility_change events with hidden=true

name: mean_compose_s
definition: mean seconds from human_turn_input_enabled to the following human_turn_submitted (Human-to-AI only)
